name: Caixa Capital
facts: Fund of funds, Caixa Empreender Award
position: Caixa Capital is the venture and private-equity arm of the Caixa Geral de Depósitos group. It invests directly in disruptive teams with global ambition, backs Portuguese VCs such as Faber and Shilling through its fund of funds, and runs the Caixa Empreender Award. Its direct portfolio spans AI software, health, energy and consumer platforms, nearly all built in Portugal.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Your direct portfolio is almost entirely Portuguese, and several of its software companies, from Amplemarket and Noxus to Hijiffy, Youverse and Growappy, sit right on top of what I've built.
summary: Caixa Capital backs Portuguese teams with global ambition, and the step that decides whether they get there is usually product and revenue, not technology. I've spent nine years on that step: AI-powered KYC at 14M-user scale, a geofencing SDK used by mobile apps, and customer operations for a New York ad platform. Your AI, identity and B2B SaaS companies are where I'd add value fastest, and as a bank-backed investor you'll appreciate that compliance-heavy products are familiar ground for me.

reasons.title: Identity and compliance, from a bank's angle
reasons.body: I owned KYC at Pi Network: ID capture, liveness, human review and fraud for 14M+ users. Youverse and the banking customers of your AI companies speak that language.

reasons.title: Conversational AI that sells
reasons.body: Hijiffy, Noxus and Amplemarket put AI agents in front of customers and sales teams. I've shipped LLM features with evals and guardrails, and built the GTM tooling they plug into.

reasons.title: Portugal-first, globally minded
reasons.body: I'm based in Lisbon, speak French, English and Portuguese, and have worked in Hong Kong and New York. I can help a Portuguese team sell abroad.
